content_of_post_to_answer: How can anxiety feel like a roller coaster that is out of control?
answer: Anxiety feels like an uncontrollable roller coaster because the brain is reacting to imagined danger as if it were already happening. The strange part is that the fear often comes less from the situation itself and more from fighting the uncertainty of not knowing what happens next. I’ve written more about this pattern on my Quora profile for anyone who wants to explore it further. Anxiety is not always a signal of danger; sometimes it is the alarm system becoming the source of the noise.
